decisions_log.decision: Used inline SVG paths for Sun/Moon icons instead of Lucide-react.
decisions_log.rationale: The deferred decision allowed either approach. Inline SVGs avoid adding a new dependency and keep the bundle small; the paths used are standard Feather/Lucide equivalents.

decisions_log.decision: Derived theme state from the DOM class via useSyncExternalStore rather than useState in an effect.
decisions_log.rationale: setState inside useEffect produces a double-render and 'not wrapped in act()' warnings in tests. useSyncExternalStore with asymmetric server/client snapshots gives synchronous, batched updates with no extra renders and no hydration mismatch.

decisions_log.decision: ThemeToggle renders a same-size aria-hidden placeholder div on the server and during initial client paint.
decisions_log.rationale: Server-rendered HTML always reflects theme='light'; rendering the real button server-side would produce the wrong icon and cause a hydration mismatch. The placeholder matches server output and prevents layout shift.

decisions_log.decision: Placed ThemeToggle inside a dedicated <header> added to RootLayout rather than any existing component.
decisions_log.rationale: Footer.tsx is not in components_touched. A <header> is the idiomatic position for site-wide controls and provides better visual affordance than a footer toggle.

decisions_log.decision: Removed the prefers-color-scheme CSS media query from globals.css.
decisions_log.rationale: Keeping the media query alongside the class-based approach would allow background colour to respond to OS preference changes even after the user has set an explicit manual preference, creating inconsistency between CSS variables and React state.

files_changed.summary: React Context provider using useSyncExternalStore to derive theme from the DOM class set by the anti-FOUC blocking script; exposes useTheme hook with theme and toggleTheme.
Client-side icon toggle (Sun/Moon SVGs) that defers rendering until mounted to avoid hydration mismatches; reads theme and toggleTheme from ThemeContext.

Injects a minimal blocking <script> in <head> to apply the .dark class before first paint (reads localStorage then falls back to prefers-color-scheme); wraps body in ThemeProvider and adds a <header> containing ThemeToggle on every page.

Added @custom-variant dark rule for Tailwind's class strategy; added .dark CSS custom-property overrides for --background and --foreground; removed the prefers-color-scheme media query to avoid conflict with class-based approach.

self_assessment.notes: All 24 tests pass (npm test --ci). Lint clean (eslint). TypeScript clean (tsc --noEmit). Production build succeeds (next build). The blocking FOUC script is minimal and inlined into <head>. Tailwind 'class' strategy is implemented via @custom-variant dark in globals.css. No third-party theme library introduced. Implementation stays within the listed components_touched.
